title: 7 Costs a Godly Man Pays Before Anyone Calls Him a Leader
caption:
7 costs a godly man pays before anyone calls him a leader. None of them come with a title.

He apologizes first, even when the blame is split. He does the job no one's watching. He absorbs the hit meant for someone else.

He says the hard thing to the person who can fire him. He shows up on the day he'd rather not. He forgives the debt before it's repaid.

And he kneels before he ever stands in front of anyone. Christ washed feet before he gave a single order.

#godlyleadership #christianmen #servantleadership #biblicalmanhood #brotherhood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
